name: neotoma-marketplace
description: Local-checkout catalog for the Neotoma Claude plugin, registered by `neotoma hooks install --tool claude-code`. Shares the name neotoma-marketplace with the repo-root catalog (markmhendrickson/neotoma) on purpose: same plugin, same install id.

plugins.name: neotoma
plugins.description: Neotoma for Claude: bundled MCP connector, onboarding skills (setup, check, recover), starter commands, and Claude Code lifecycle hooks. The same package ships a Cursor hook map (.cursor/hooks.json).
